An editorial illustration features a black background with a large red title "TEMPO" across the top. Above the title, text in white reads "ANCAMAN LEDAKAN ORANG LANJUT USIA / MENGAPA DPR DUKUNG RUU SAWIT". Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is partially visible. 

Dominating the center is a stylized illustration of a human arm and open hand, palms up. The arm is grey, suggesting a sleeve, while the hand is white with black outlines and line work indicating palm creases. Below the arm, a large pool of flat red color resembling liquid extends towards the bottom left. Scattered around the arm and hand are five silver-colored screws and one silver-colored safety pin. One screw is near the upper-left, one near the wrist, two are on the right, and one is near the bottom right. 

In the bottom right, large white block text reads "MALAM JAHANAM DI KAMPUNG MELAYU". The The bottom left contains small red and white text including "29 MEI-4 JUNI 2017", "RP 45.000", and a barcode. A solid red vertical stripe runs along the far left edge.
